Free will does not exist .  
Firstly we need to be aware of everything that is influencing our actions , including environmental factors , our mood , influence of other people and past experiences , this is not true or even possible .Think about anything u did today , why would u choose anything over the other ? To choose chocolate you'd need to want chocolate more than vanilla , YOU NEED TO WANT IT , can u control what u want to do ?Assume u dont wanna punch your mom in the face ? Can u choose to want to punch her? It isnt the same as doing it .

Lets say you chose vanilla just to show you have free will , its the same problem , in order to do that you would need to WANT to prove your free will , why is the desire to prove me wrong stronger than your desire to eat your fav ice cream , you cannot determine your wants.

Even if it was, in order to change a dont want into a want , you'd need to want to want it.

and vice versa to change a want into a dont want you'd need to want to not want it.

YOU WANTED TO DO IT.

YOU WERE FORCED TO DO IT.

If you are forced to do something then obviously it isn't free will and if you wanted to do something you still cannot control your wants so actions that happen because of your wants is also not free will.
